name: Remote Control Console
description: This suite includes the proper equipment necessary for a crewmember to take remote control of another ship from the safety of their own ship. A number of crewmembers can be deployed at a time in remote ships from this suite equal to one quarter of the ship’s suite capacity by size, as shown in the **[Starship Size Suite Capacity](#Starship%20Size%20Suite%20Capacity)** table. The distance at which this suite can connect to remote ships is limited by the communications of the ship this suite is installed in.
